answer: Oak staves stand in a ring on the cooper's bench, smelling of the fire they were bent over. Proof of cooper via hooped barrel tally — a barrel the cooper hoops only after 683 barrels hoop true without one stave leaking at the chime, each hooped by the cooper himself. ripple drives the hoops down with the driver and the mallet. lotus planes the chime and fits the head. voyage fills the barrel with water and watches for the weep. Six hundred and eighty-three barrels must hoop true without one stave leaking at the chime, and the next still leaks where the stave ran short.
